question: In Box: Add the tag escalate to the file that has an open review task, due before October 1, 2026, which Dana Whitfield assigned to two or more people.
final:

| File | Open review task | Due < Oct 1, 2026 | Created by Dana | 2+ assignees (by Dana) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Education pricing.xlsx** (9004) | ✅ "Review education discounts" | ❌ due **2026-10-15** | ✅ | ✅ (Omar Haddad, Sam Rivera) |
| **Government pricing.xlsx** (9006) | ✅ "Review government tiers" | ✅ 2026-09-20 | ✅ | ❌ both assignments made **by Sam Rivera**, not Dana |
| **Nonprofit pricing.xlsx** (9005) | ✅ "Review nonprofit tiers" | ✅ 2026-09-20 | ✅ | ❌ only 1 assignee (Omar Haddad) |
| **Partner pricing.xlsx** (9003) | ❌ "Review partner margins" is **completed** | ✅ 2026-09-20 | ✅ | ✅ |
| **SMB pricing.xlsx** (9002) | ✅ "Review SMB tiers" | ✅ 2026-09-20 | ✅ | ❌ only 1 assignee; its 2-assignee task is completed |

The closest candidates:
- **Education pricing.xlsx** — matches everything except the due date (Oct 15, *after* Oct 1).
- **Government pricing.xlsx** — matches everything except that Dana created the task but **Sam Rivera** made the two assignments.

Want me to tag one of these anyway (e.g., Education, if the due date was misstated), or leave things as-is?
